Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)
Output: Figure2c-2f in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure2` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure2`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/Figure2cd.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))
endometriosis <- c("Simple endometriosis", "Atypical endometriosis", "Cancer-like endometriosis")

keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "PanCK" & spe_ruv$Category %in% endometriosis
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(CLE_SE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Simple_endometriosis,
                              AE_CLE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Atypical_endometriosis,
                              levels = colnames(design))

efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))$efit

topTable_CLE_SE <- top_table(efit, "CLE_SE")
topTable_AE_CLE <- top_table(efit, "AE_CLE")
save_tables(list(PanCK_CLE_SE = topTable_CLE_SE, PanCK_CLE_AE = topTable_AE_CLE), "Figure2cd.xlsx")
```

##### Figure 2c-d: volcano plots
```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
Figure2c <- plot_volcano(topTable_CLE_SE, sig_genes_in(topTable_CLE_SE, volcano_genes_endometriosis),
                         col_low = "#20854EFF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(0, 6),
                         left = "SE", right = "CLE", caption_y = 5.5, print_scale = 255 / 720)   # 10 in printed 255 pt wide
Figure2d <- plot_volcano(topTable_AE_CLE, sig_genes_in(topTable_AE_CLE, volcano_genes_endometriosis),
                         col_low = "#0073C2FF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(0, 7),
                         left = "AE", right = "CLE", caption_y = 6.5, print_scale = 255 / 720)
Figure2c
Figure2d

save_plot(Figure2c, "Figure2c.svg", width = 10, height = 9)
save_plot(Figure2d, "Figure2d.svg", width = 10, height = 9)
save_source_data(volcano_source(Figure2c), "Figure2c")
save_source_data(volcano_source(Figure2d), "Figure2d")
```

##### Figure 2e: GSEA, MSigDB Hallmarks
```{r, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 7.9}
gene_lists <- list("CLE vs SE" = ranked_logfc(efit, "CLE_SE"),
                   "AE vs CLE" = ranked_logfc(efit, "AE_CLE"))

gseaMsigdbr_list <- lapply(gene_lists, gsea_hallmark)

# Narrow, tall panels so the text stays readable on the page (gsea_theme() in Helpers.R)
Figure2e <- plot_grid(plot_gsea(gseaMsigdbr_list[["CLE vs SE"]], label_format = 26, right = "CLE", left = "SE",
                                x_left = -2.5, x_right = 3.2, caption_size = 2.4) + gsea_theme(0.5, 22),
                      plot_gsea(gseaMsigdbr_list[["AE vs CLE"]], label_format = 26, right = "CLE", left = "AE",
                                x_left = -2.5, x_right = 3.2, caption_size = 2.4) + gsea_theme(0.5, 22),
                      nrow = 1)
Figure2e

save_plot(Figure2e, "Figure2e.svg", width = 6.5, height = 7.9)
save_source_data(list(CLE_vs_SE = gsea_source(gseaMsigdbr_list[["CLE vs SE"]]),
                      CLE_vs_AE = gsea_source(gseaMsigdbr_list[["AE vs CLE"]])),
                 "Figure2e")
```

##### Figure 2f: GSEA, GO biological process
```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8.8}
gseaGO_list <- lapply(gene_lists, gsea_go)

Figure2f <- plot_grid(plot_gsea(gseaGO_list[["CLE vs SE"]], show = 40, label_format = 60,
                                right = "CLE", left = "SE", x_right = 3, x_left = -3, caption_size = 2.4) +
                        gsea_theme(0.75, 30, nes_breaks = c(-3, 0, 3), nes_limits = c(-3.6, 3.6)) +
                        scale_size(range = c(1.5, 5)),
                      plot_gsea(gseaGO_list[["AE vs CLE"]], show = 40, label_format = 60,
                                right = "CLE", left = "AE", x_right = 3, x_left = -3, caption_size = 2.4) +
                        gsea_theme(0.75, 30, nes_breaks = c(-3, 0, 3), nes_limits = c(-3.6, 3.6)) +
                        scale_size(range = c(1.5, 5)),
                      nrow = 1)
Figure2f

save_plot(Figure2f, "Figure2f.svg", width = 9, height = 8.8)
save_source_data(list(CLE_vs_SE = gsea_source(gseaGO_list[["CLE vs SE"]], show = 40),
                      CLE_vs_AE = gsea_source(gseaGO_list[["AE vs CLE"]], show = 40)),
                 "Figure2f")
```
